$description: Primitive design tokens — the raw Binance identity values, captured from the shipped globals.css / theme.ts (spec 129, PR-F1). Hand-edit ONLY files in apps/web/tokens/; everything else is generated. Never reference primitives directly from component code — consume semantic tokens.

breakpoint.$description: One breakpoint set, replacing the ad-hoc 440/639/767/768/1023 scatter. Boundaries align to the shipped media queries (max-width 639/767, min-width 768, max-width 1023).

container.$description: Container scale for max-w-* (Tailwind v4 defaults). Named separately from the spacing ladder: in Tailwind v4, max-w-<key> also resolves through the --spacing-* namespace, so the spacing tokens' xs/sm/md/lg/xl names silently captured max-w-md (=12px) etc. until this scale was defined (found by spec 142's mobile e2e on PR-136A: the login card collapsed to a 12px max-width).

goldFocus.$description: Pre-computed focus ring / focus border (both modes) — replaces hand-mixed rgba()

darkStrong.$description: Dark-mode strong border (existing Binance-family grey, used for the dark idle dot)

darkHairline.$description: Binance hairline on dark — same value as the dark elevated surface, borders read as surface steps

bronze.$description: Deep gold — light-mode focus ring and light-mode link colour only, retained for readability on white (bright yellow is unreadable as light-mode link text)

emerald.$description: Binance trading up — positive status, operational states (Binance live UI)

gold.$description: Binance Yellow — primary brand accent, primary buttons, active moments, inline links on dark (Binance live UI primary)

peru.$description: Binance Yellow Active — classic Binance yellow, pressed/hover state of the primary gold

rose.$description: Binance trading down — negative status, error states, critical alerts (Binance live UI; unchanged, already matched)

400.$description: Binance muted-strong — dark-mode secondary text, light-mode muted text

500.$description: Binance muted — dark-mode muted text, light-mode secondary text

mutedLight.$description: Light-mode idle status dot only (no longer used as light-mode muted text)

slateText.$description: Light-mode secondary text; dark-mode idle dot

black.$description: Pitch black — dark canvas, text on primary

slate.$description: Pitch slate — dark hairline borders, dividers, dark hover surface

white.$description: Pure white — dark-mode primary text (21.0:1 AAA on black), light-mode panel

darkActive.$description: Binance surface elevated dark — dark-mode active/pressed surface, also the dark hairline value

darkPanel.$description: Binance surface card dark — dark-mode panel surface

darkSubtle.$description: Dark-mode subtle/recessed surface — interpolated step between Binance canvas (#0b0e11) and card (#1e2329), same blue-grey family

lightActive.$description: Binance hairline on light — light-mode active/pressed surface

lightCanvas.$description: Binance canvas light — light-mode page floor

lightHover.$description: Binance surface strong light — light-mode hover surface

lightSubtle.$description: Binance surface soft light — light-mode subtle surface

darkCanvas.$description: Binance canvas dark — near-black with a slight blue tint, never pure black

darkHover.$description: Dark-mode hover surface — interpolated step between Binance card (#1e2329) and elevated (#2b3139)

darkPrimary.$description: Binance body on dark — deliberately not pure white

lightPrimary.$description: Binance ink — strongest text on light, and black text on yellow primary CTAs

mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

size.$description: Type scale — 1.25 modular ratio on a 13px product body (compact default density — Shahzeb, 2026-10-24; spec 129 OD-4 as amended). The 12px step is the named metadata step (body − 1px), not an accident.

body.$description: Product body size (1rem = 16px; body renders at 0.8125rem — the legacy app's de-facto size, now the specced compact default)

metadata.$description: Named metadata step — dense tables, captions, secondary labels

motion.$description: Motion — exit faster than enter (exit uses the next-shorter duration step). Reduced-motion handling lives in the base CSS layer (PR-F2).

full.$description: Circular avatars and round indicators only

md.$description: Cards, data tables, sheet containers, dialog modals

sm.$description: Buttons, form text inputs, select triggers

shadow.$description: Elevation — tonal surface steps + hairlines are the depth mechanism; shadows exist ONLY for true overlays (menus, dialogs, toasts) and raised cards, per mode.

space.$description: Spacing ladder — 4/8 system (spec 129 §5.2). The xs–xxxl steps mirror the legacy SPACING export; section/page steps extend the ladder to 64/96.

lg.$description: Standard container padding, card inner margins

sm.$description: Compact element spacing, input internal padding Y

state.$description: Pre-computed state values (Geist pattern) — components consume these instead of hand-mixing rgba() or opacity at the usage site.

zIndex.$description: Named z-index scale (spec 129 §5.2) replacing the 9500/9999/10000 arms race. Step VALUES preserve today's effective stacking order for existing usages — see the usage→step mapping in PR-F1. F1 defines the tokens only; usage sites migrate in specs 130–136.

base.$description: Normal flow; absorbs today's local 1/2/3/20/40/50/100 stacking inside components

overlayTop.$description: Topmost overlay — desktop titlebar and tooltips (today's 10000 usages; currently the highest stacking in the app)

sticky.$description: Sticky chrome — sidebar container (CSS z-index 30 today) and its rail (20, inside the container's stacking context)

toast.$description: Toasts and top-level guards (today's 9999 usages — ui/dialog overlay tier, leave-page guard, media import staging, media library header)
